command:
set -eu
git fetch origin main agent-control
git show origin/agent-control:.agent/tasks/tracker-phase2-close-docs-r2-20260907-0945.json > /tmp/tracker-phase2-close-docs-r2.json
python3 - <<'PY'

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/tmp/tracker-phase2-close-docs-r2.json')

insert="python3 - <<'PY2'\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfor name in ['docs/PHASE2_CLOSURE_AUDIT.md','docs/PHASE3_HANDOFF.md']:\n    p=Path(name)\n    p.write_text('\\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in p.read_text().splitlines()) + '\\n')\nPY2\ngit diff --check\n! grep -q 'Current recovery phase.*Phase 2' README.md"

    raise SystemExit('injection point not found')

raise SystemExit(subprocess.call(['/bin/sh','-c',cmd]))
